```{=html}
<div class="field-explorer">
  <header class="field-header"><div><p class="field-eyebrow">MLSYSBOOK · EXPLORE</p><h1>ML systems taxonomy</h1><p>Find an idea. See its connections. Read it in the books.</p></div><div class="field-header-tools"><div class="field-global-search"><label class="field-search-label" for="field-search">Find a concept</label><div class="field-search-wrap"><input id="field-search" type="search" placeholder="Search names or ideas…" autocomplete="off"><button id="field-clear-search" type="button" aria-label="Clear search" hidden>Clear</button></div></div><a id="field-book-atlas" href="volume-maps.html">Volume maps ↗</a></div></header>
  <a class="field-skip" href="#field-concepts">Skip to concept list</a><a class="field-skip" href="#field-detail">Skip to selected concept</a>

  <a id="field-browse" class="field-back-browser" hidden>← Back to explorer</a>
  <div class="field-browser">
    <div class="field-sidebar" role="complementary" aria-label="Browse the taxonomy">
      <label class="field-topic-select" for="field-topic-select">Topic<select id="field-topic-select"><option value="" disabled selected>Choose a topic</option></select></label>
      <nav id="field-taxonomy" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Topics and concept groups"></nav>
    </div>
    <section id="field-concepts" class="field-concepts" aria-label="Concept list" tabindex="-1"><button id="field-all-topics" type="button" class="field-mobile-back">← All topics</button><h2 id="field-topic-title">Choose a topic</h2><p id="field-topic-question">Browse the topics to find an area you want to explore.</p><p id="field-results" class="field-results" role="status"></p><div id="field-list"></div></section>
    <div class="field-reader">
      <button id="field-topic-back" class="field-mobile-back" type="button">← Concepts</button>
      <nav id="field-breadcrumb" class="field-breadcrumb" aria-label="Concept location"></nav>
      <section id="field-detail" class="field-detail" aria-label="Selected concept" tabindex="-1"><h2>Choose a concept</h2><p>Open a topic on the left, or search for an idea.</p></section>
      <div id="field-tabs" class="field-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Explore this concept" hidden><button id="field-text-tab" role="tab" type="button" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="field-connections">Connections</button><button id="field-map-tab" role="tab" type="button" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="field-map-panel" tabindex="-1">Map</button></div>
      <section id="field-connections" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="field-text-tab"></section>
      <section id="field-map-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="field-map-tab" hidden><section class="field-map-region" aria-label="Concept connections" hidden>
        <div class="field-map-heading"><h2>See the connections</h2><a id="field-expand" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Expand map ↗</a></div>
        <p id="field-status" class="field-status" role="status">Loading connections…</p>
        <div class="field-map-tools"><button id="field-return" type="button" hidden>Back to landscape</button><button id="field-fit" type="button">Fit</button><button id="field-minus" type="button" aria-label="Zoom out">−</button><button id="field-plus" type="button" aria-label="Zoom in">+</button><button id="field-neighbors" type="button" disabled>Focus connections</button><details class="field-map-options"><summary>Map options</summary><label for="field-view">Show</label><select id="field-view"><option value="overview">Selected connections</option><option value="all">Full draft landscape</option><option value="focus" disabled>Concept connections</option></select><a id="field-download" href="field-overview.svg" download>Download SVG</a></details></div>
        <div id="field-canvas" class="field-canvas" tabindex="0" aria-label="Interactive concept map. Arrow keys pan; plus and minus zoom; Home fits; Escape returns to the Connections text."><img class="field-static" src="field-overview.svg" alt="Selected concept relationships."></div>
        <p class="field-gesture">Drag to pan · Ctrl/⌘ + scroll to zoom · Keyboard: arrows, +, −, Home</p>
        <p class="field-legend">Each arrow reads as a sentence. Its conditions appear in the Connections tab.</p>
      </section></section>
    </div>
  </div>
  <details class="field-method"><summary>About this taxonomy / For editors</summary><p>Topics collect related ideas; concept groups contain explicitly authored broader and narrower subjects. These are navigation structures, not a required learning sequence. The subject hierarchy remains a small pilot.</p><p>Draft map. Book links are candidate passages with teaching depth not yet assessed. Missing links do not establish missing coverage. Concept relationships are conditional editorial drafts; external sources stay in the authoring registry.</p><p id="field-model-summary"></p><p><a href="taxonomy-reference.md" download>Written taxonomy draft</a> · <a href="taxonomy.ttl" download>SKOS vocabulary</a></p><noscript><p>This browser requires JavaScript. Open the <a href="field-overview.svg">static concept map</a> or download the written taxonomy draft.</p></noscript></details>
</div>
<script src="field.js" defer></script>
```
